turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Alright, we're rolling. The street is quiet tonight, just the way we planned it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Quiet is good. Last time the corner was crawling with onlookers before we even started.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: I brought the chalk. We can mark the lines before the crowd shows up.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Mark them wide. Nobody should be guessing where the boundary is.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And the water table? Somebody has to keep the bottles on ice.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: I already filled the cooler. Ice, towels, and a spare roll of tape.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. Now we just wait for the lights to come on over the alley.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: When they do, we walk in steady. No rush, no noise.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Steady wins. The ones who rush always trip on the first line.
